# Agent readiness audit

We read *every* line & report what an agent can **actually** use. The audit costs 490 € and takes 5 working days.

## What you get

* A scored report (0–100)
* A list of [llms.txt](/guides/llms-txt) findings
* Re-scan after 30 days
